name: Witchkeeping
summary: 开发者承认使用 AI 辅助编程、调试和本地化。试玩书封存在 AI 质疑；开发者表示无法核实外包方的否认，已开始替换，美术争议尚不能定案。

sources.label: Please post an AI disclosure
sources.excerpt: 玩家质疑试玩书封；开发者先否认 AI 美术，后承认无法核实外包方的否认，报告已替换 11 张并计划继续替换。不能据此确认全部替换已完成。

sources.label: Steam 开发者回复：AI 辅助开发及书封争议
sources.excerpt: 开发者承认使用 AI 辅助编程、调试和本地化；10 月 22 日表示无法核实外包书封是否使用生成式 AI，已开始替换。

reviewNote: 核对正式版 Steam 身份、完整商店页、讨论区首页全部 14 个主题，并读完 AI 质疑帖及可见 15 条回复，另做独立网络检索。商店没有 AI 生成内容披露栏；使用结论来自带开发者标识的回复，不是商店披露。10 月 14 日的美术否认已被 10 月 22 日更审慎的说明修正：外包方否认使用 AI，但开发者无法核实，并报告已替换 11 张书封、计划继续替换。未确认全部替换完成，也不把试玩素材质疑扩展为正式版已确认使用 AI 美术。开发者对音频及写作的早期否认未作独立审计。

english.summary: The developer acknowledges AI-assisted coding, debugging and localization. Players questioned demo book covers; the developer could not verify the contractor’s denial and began replacing them. AI-generated art remains unconfirmed.
english.reviewNote: Verified the full-game Steam identity, complete store page, all 14 visible discussion titles, the AI thread and its 15 visible replies, plus a separate web search. The store has no AI disclosure section; the use finding comes from developer-badged replies. The October 14 art denial was qualified on October 22: the contractor denied AI use, but the developer could not verify this and reported 11 replacement covers with more planned. Completion was not verified. Demo-art allegations are not proof of AI art in the full release. Earlier audio and writing denials were not independently audited.
